comments.author: JD
comments.body: I found the landing port(coords: 14419,4916) west of pernambuco the best place to collect lots of them, Once you land run right then left at the first cross road till you get to the dead tree that's the best place.

comments.author: Arlen
comments.body: Does anyone know where a really good place is to get this? Like in the range of 3-5 per collection?

comments.author: Arlen
comments.body: well, northwest portobelo has large leaves in abundance. A lot more than the landing west of pernambuco. There is a table rock to the right of the entrance, but there are a few other landmarks that are better and more specialized, such as a flower with red flowers and stacked boulders with an abundance of leaves.

comments.author: Hans
comments.body:
On the left hand side of the screen, somewhere between the sign in box and the HOME hypertext, there is an option under SKILLS called "collection"

If you click on that you will find a fairly extensive (but incomplete) listing of all the landing spots and outskirts along with what can be collected there. It is extremely usefull.
